claim: Safari de Peaugres 2026 adult ticket €29.90 (11+), child €25.50 (3-10), under 3 free; ~4+ hour visit with 5 km drive-through safari (1h) plus minimum 3 hour walking section across 80 ha with 1,200 animals.
quote: Adulte (11+) : 29,90 € ... Enfant (3-10 ans) : 25,50 €. Circuit safari en voiture: 5 km circuit covering one hour across two continents. Walking section: Minimum 3 hours.

claim: Safari de Peaugres operates April–September daily 10:00–18:30 (9:30–19:00 in July-August), with low-season limited days (Fri-Sun in Jan-Feb plus school holidays).
quote: Avril à septembre, ouverture tous les jours de 10h à 18h30 (9h30 à 19h en juillet-août). Basse saison: vendredis et week-ends plus tous les jours pendant les vacances scolaires.

claim: Driving distance from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid to Peaugres is roughly 36 km / 40 minutes — just outside the 30 km radius but easy day trip.
quote: La distance pour aller de Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid à Peaugres est de 36 kilomètres et le trajet dure 40 minutes.

claim: Velay Express 2026 runs Sundays and May public holidays May-October, plus Wednesdays and Thursdays from 16 July to 31 August; route stops at Raucoules, Tence, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and Saint-Agrève (Dunières section closed since 2015).
quote: De mai à octobre les dimanches et pont de mai. Du 16 juillet au 31 août les mercredis et jeudis. Gares: Raucoules, Tence, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon, Saint-Agrève.

claim: Velay Express 2026 tickets: adult €16.50–€22.50, child (4-12) €13.50–€19.50, family (2A+2C) €54–€78, under 4 free on lap; both steam (vapeur) and diesel (autorail) trains operate the heritage Galoche line.
quote: Adulte: 16,50€ à 22,50€. Enfant (4-12 ans): 13,50€ à 19,50€. Famille (2 adultes + 2 enfants): 54€ à 78€. Train à vapeur ... à bord d'un train d'autrefois.

claim: Lac de Devesset is a 50-hectare lake at 1,100 m altitude on the Ardèche plateau with sandy beach, supervised swimming July–August 13:30–18:30, pedalos/paddleboards/windsurf rentals, mini-golf, 3.5 km loop trail and snack bar.
quote: Supervised swimming every day from 1.30 pm to 6.30 pm in July and August. Pedal boats, paddleboards, and windsurfing rentals. 3.5 km trail encircles the lake.

claim: Lac de Devesset access fees: €2 visitor, €3 for 2-wheelers, €5 for cars (last two weekends of June, July, August, first two weekends of September); free outside that window.
quote: Free for residents, €2 for visitors, €3 for 2-wheelers (until 6 PM), €5 for 4-wheelers, €2 after 4 PM. Vehicle access paid during last two weekends of June, July and August.

claim: Parcours Acrobatiques des Sucs in Yssingeaux (440 chemin de Rachessac, 43200) offers four colour-graded courses (yellow from age 3), two ziplines and a 20 m bungy ejection; 3-hour session pricing €7 (ages 3-6), €15 (7-10), €20 (10+).
quote: Yellow course: Ages 3-6 (€7). Green/blue/tyrolienne 1: Ages 7-10 or 1.20m+ (€15). Red/tyrolienne 2: Ages 10+ or 1.40m+ (€20). 440 chemin de Rachessac, 43200 Yssingeaux.

claim: Parcours Acrobatique des Sucs opens 30 April–20 September 2026 by reservation, daily 10:00–18:30.
quote: Le parc est ouvert du 30 avril 2026 au 20 septembre 2026, mais uniquement sur réservation. Tous les jours de 10h00 à 18h30.

claim: NaturaLoisirs (9 rue du Velay, Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid) rents electric and standard bikes (Giant partner), open Thu-Sun in spring (10-19h), Wed-Sun July-September.
quote: Location et vente de vélo (Giant). Apr-Jun: Thursday-Sunday, 10am-7pm. Jul-Sep: Wednesday-Sunday, 10am-7pm. 9 Rue du Velay, 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.

claim: Les Marraignes asinerie in Saint-Agrève (Ardèche, ~15 km from Saint-Bonnet) offers donkey-accompanied walks, farm visits, brushing and feeding; school-holiday sessions Tue-Thu 10:00-11:30 and Fri 16:30-18:00, capacity 50.
quote: Commune: Saint-Agrève. Donkey visits and encounters. Weekdays (Tuesday-Thursday): 10:00-11:30 AM. Fridays: 4:30-6:00 PM. Capacity: Limited to 50 people per visit.

claim: Les Marraignes donkey hikes start from €15; one packed donkey covers 3-4 adults for a full day, with 30 min briefing on handling before departure; asinerie visits free with optional donation.
quote: Hikes with donkeys start from €15. For a full day hike, one donkey is sufficient for 3 or even 4 adults. Approximately 30 minutes instruction on handling. Free admission to asinerie, donations welcome.

claim: Parc Family Aventure at La Séauve-sur-Semène (43140) — eastern Haute-Loire, beyond the 30 km radius — offers 17 accrobranche courses, escape game, giant pendulum jump and treehouses; Initiation pack €12 (age 3+), Discovery €15 (age 4+).
quote: Plan d'eau / Base de loisirs - lieu dit Vaujalat, 43140, La Séauve-sur-Semène. INITIATION €12 per person for 4 green courses (ages 3+, max 1h30). DISCOVERY €15 for 9 courses with giant zipline.
